title: Telegram Bot
description: A Telegram Bot source node that receives messages from users via the Telegram Bot API.
Supports text messages and media files (images, audio, voice, video, documents).
Each message type is routed to the appropriate pipeline lane.
Pipeline responses are automatically sent back as replies to the sender.
Supports both long polling (for local/private setups) and webhook (for production).

telegram.mode.title: Connection Mode
telegram.mode.description: Polling works anywhere without a public URL. Webhook requires a public HTTPS endpoint.

telegram.webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
telegram.webhookUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL Telegram will POST updates to (e.g. https://your-server.com/telegram/webhook). Required for webhook mode; ignored when polling.
